exoticPerks.name: The Gift of Certainty
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improves Ascension and Tempest Strike.
exoticPerks.description: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.

descriptions.flavorText: BRAINVAULT Sigma-ACTIUM-IX Cranial Dreadnought (Invincible Type)

exoticPerks.name: Transfusion Matrix
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Arc melee kills grant health and melee energy.
exoticPerks.description: Final blows with Arc melees trigger health regeneration and fully restore a melee charge. Melee hits grant Arc melee energy.

descriptions.flavorText: No ammo? No problem.

exoticPerks.name: Force Multiplier
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Shotgun and melee final blows start health regeneration and extend defensive buffs.
exoticPerks.description: Shotgun and melee final blows start your health regeneration. While you have a defensive buff (Void Overshield, Amplified, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail), your Shotguns and melees deal additional damage and final blows with either extend the duration of those buffs. Provides a moderate benefit to Shotgun airborne effectiveness and reload speed.

descriptions.flavorText: 13.4 billion years ago, the first stars kindled out of darkness, seeding the future of all life.

exoticPerks.name: Fusion Harness
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Extra Fusion Grenade. Grenade kills charge Rift.
exoticPerks.description: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.

descriptions.flavorText: The manifestation of pseudophotons and impossible math.

exoticPerks.name: Blessing of Order
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Rifts create beneficial seeker projectiles.
exoticPerks.description: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.
